app.tagline: See it, hear it, take it apart — learn and write with chords

home.title: Welcome to ChordLab
home.body: ChordLab is under construction. The table shows what each module will do and when it is planned; you can already try the audio engine under “Engine check” on the left.

section.piano: Play on the keyboard and click a chord to hear and see its notes.
section.lessons: Understand chords step by step, from intervals to harmonic function.
section.analysis: Import songs, detect their chords and find the patterns.
section.arrange: Write melodies and drums, mix and export.
